authority: LR-DETAIL-DECISIONS-02; 2026-11-24 user: 너가 권장한대로 설계를 하는데 설계 결정사항들에 대해서 나를 설득해봐

decisions.choice: 공통 업무 데이터 3개 구조와 타입이 명시된 하위 값; 별도 테이블 수 미정
decisions.why: 원본/프로필만 재사용, 등록 요청이 준비·승인·실행·결과 단위. 물리 분리 강제 근거 없음.
decisions.alternative: 각 단계별 엔터티/API, 또는 구조 없는 JSON
decisions.timing: 병렬 구현 전에 의미/타입 필요, DB는 통합 기술 결정 뒤

decisions.choice: 공통 봉투는 닫힌 스키마, 실제 등록값은 플랫폼 프로필 타입과 별도 조건 검사
decisions.why: 오류/타입/상태/필드를 일치시키되 크몽 가격·이미지와 숨고 문항의 차이 보존. 누락/null/false/0 구분.
decisions.alternative: 모든 플랫폼 동일 필드 또는 자유형 JSON

decisions.choice: 9개 업무 API 유지, 인증은 등록 요청의 open/finish/close/refresh 명령. 준비/인증 확인은 설정된 시간 내 응답, 실패는 실행 수락 전 안내; 실행만 비동기 job, GET 조회
decisions.why: 장시간 브라우저 업무에서 연결 종료와 작업 분리 필요. 준비 단계에 별도 비동기 작업/상태/폴링 시스템은 현 근거로 필요 없음. 초과 시간은 명확한 실패/재시도 가능.
decisions.alternative: 모든 요청 동기 실행 또는 모두 job/별도 인증 resource
decisions.timing: UI-서버 동작 합의 선행; 실제 timeout 수치는 측정 후

decisions.choice: 서버가 승인 범위 digest와 revision을 생성하고 start에서 원자 수락; 일반적인 요청 키·대상/동작 키
decisions.why: 중복 클릭/응답 유실, 오래된 화면, 다른 요청 키로 기존 효과 재발급 방지. 새 idempotency subsystem 불필요.
decisions.alternative: 클라이언트 임의 계획/키만 믿기 또는 단계별 사용자 승인
decisions.timing: 저장/실행 경계를 독립 구현 전 정의

decisions.choice: 준비/인증/실행/판정의 5개 업무 포트, 실행기는 의미 있는 단계 내 실제 mutation 경계에서만 durable admission; 판정은 프로필 증거
decisions.why: UI 조작 호출 자체가 성공을 증명하지 않음. 단계 묶음은 화면 표시 목적, 개별 효과 경계가 다르면 안전 검사를 생략할 수 없음. 모든 클릭 로그는 불필요.
decisions.alternative: AI 임의 실행, 모든 DOM 클릭 독립 업무 단계, 결과 무조건 재조회
decisions.timing: adapter/공통 실행 경계 필요, 실제 DOM 세부·toolkit은 위임

decisions.choice: 웹 UI + 하나의 논리 앱 + 공통 영속 저장소 + 격리된 원격 브라우저 실행 영역, 추가 microservice/메시지 브로커 없음; 같은 프로세스/별도 실행자 여부는 후속
decisions.why: 소규모 팀/단일 등록 흐름, 공유 상태/승인/중단 원자성. 원격 브라우저 격리와 작업 수명은 별도 보장. 분산 서비스의 계약/배포 비용 불필요.
decisions.alternative: 책임별 독립 서비스 또는 브라우저/앱 완전 혼합
decisions.timing: 통합 배치 경계만 필요. DB/framework/worker/transport는 11/27 독립 결과 판단

decisions.choice: 지원 프로필과 실제 플랫폼 규칙의 검증 수준을 명시; 현재 두 mock value schema는 통합 설계 fixture, 실제 업체 필드나 팀원 독립 계약 강제 아님
decisions.why: 조사 보고가 실제 지원·권한·저장 증거를 대체할 수 없음. 숨고 실제 목표 미확정.
decisions.alternative: 미확인 live 규칙을 고정하거나 모든 설계 보류
decisions.timing: 모의 인터페이스 검증 가능, 실제 지원은 별도 gate

routes.purpose: resolve and prepare; no separate draft resource
answer necessary questions or revise before acceptance
auth lifecycle and target check; viewer transport not business API
atomic approval/accept; returns tracked request/job, async execution is product behavior

ports.error: unsupported/blocked is a value, not runtime error
blocking issues or typed model/runtime error before accept; no fabricated fields
prestart error only, revoke invalid viewer grant; no target proof on unknown account
error stop; durable checkpoints via shared infrastructure; report after operations and goal observation
missing required evidence not success; CO closes state; no browser mutation

semantic_rules: raw_text or at least one valid asset; source is immutable snapshot. Asset part_name unique and exact multipart manifest; reject unmatched bytes, unsafe type or no explicit rights for use. Store original rights flag, block readiness when false; source reuse owner only.

supported profile only; missing/invalid/unverified/rights unknown issues marked blocking. ready iff required profile fields valid, no blocking issues and all proposed semantic facts have actual source/answer evidence; wording proposal may be reviewed, no invented facts. Source/answers scoped to registration. Validate exact conditional/optional rules; preserve units and zero/false. Unsupported is normal prestart result.

KmongValues/SoomgoValues are synthetic fixture schemas: in_person/hybrid requires region; main_image rights true, 652x488 mock fixture; region absent permitted online; exact package amounts/period/units preserved, VAT boolean false valid. Soomgo arrays nonempty unique mock enum, no main_image. Real rules and actual object not decided.

open only prestart ready and current revision; finish/close/refresh expected generation matches current auth grant/session; close prestart only (including verified connection), refresh only human input phase; actual user secrets stay in remote runtime. finish fences human input, bounded identity + target lookup, returns verified target or error; on timeout close/fence and prestart retry. H8/H9 never return grants. Viewer close alone not job stop. H6 grant only open/refresh.

review present only ready+verified+new+allowed; show actual values/assets/target/goal/steps and no rollback/cancel notice. Server canonical digest includes immutable scope. Start checks owner, current registration revision, reviewed digest, source/profile/target/account/policy/connection and effect ledger. H7 first successful acceptance durably creates active job + scope + key in one transaction, before runner dispatch. Return 202; replay first lookup key scoped owner+start, same registration ID+payload returns 200 current persisted view; different payload -> 409 even terminal/expired. User mutation after start denied; results read only.

stable effect key is typed tuple environment+platform+external_account_ref+object_kind+slot_ref+logical_operation_id, not request ID/title or arbitrary client value. Server resolves stable slot using existing intent and platform evidence; same intent retains slot across attempts/requests. If uncertain, target ambiguous and block start; distinct actual lesson intent may have distinct slot. Existing result returned only if owner authorized. No external exactly-once claim.

server validates active/current scope+permission+same account+lease generation+revision+allowed bound action+before-state and prior effect key before admitting each potentially mutating logical operation; durable admission/unique key before sending browser command. Read-only operations also scoped; uncertain classification potential_effect. Step groups may contain multiple operations; adapter declares each potential effect and stable operation ID, not each click log. No raw browser access bypass; stop fences future admissions. After admitted crash/response loss, preserve unknown, never replay uncertain command. Technical transport retry only if cannot repeat external mutation; not user resume.

goal confirmed only matching approved scope's target, goal_kind, canonical payload digest and required evidence (Kmong also approved asset digest); both current mock profiles require trusted independent readback. Profile may later allow trusted response proof without readback. Error => stopping -> stopped with known/absent/unknown effects and goal verdict. Goal not_reached only authoritative absence or known no goal-capable effect dispatched under profile; else unknown. done requires goal confirmed and no unresolved effects; no user resume/cancel/edit. Late trusted read-only observations append evidence without reopening lifecycle. No real receipt/publication claim.

server only mock, supported origins allowlist at runtime. Owner derives from service identity; no raw credentials/OTP/cookies/driver handles to app logs/LLM/public response. Any external permission/auth loss after acceptance system error. GET uses persisted data only.

server-only canonical UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted by Unicode code units, no whitespace, arrays in declared order, numbers integer safe range, strings Unicode preserved (no silent normalization), exact allowed fields only, SHA256. Revision/source/profile/values/provenance/asset digest/target/procedure/goal included; exclude mutable display labels, viewer grants/session secrets/time. Server generates and client echoes digest; no client hash authority. Profile hash uses same canonical rules on versioned content; key replay digest includes route registration id and StartInput excluding request_key. Canonical implementation/test vector shared at integration.

H5 needs at least one of source_id/selector/answers, unique current issue IDs; cannot patch values/approval directly. Source/selector change clears incompatible answers and review; answers update preparation; auth human/verifying must close first. Verified connection invalidated on material change. H1/H4 resource creation no external mutation, duplicate resources alone safe; no start until semantic target guard.

job_state null means prestart; supported requires profile_ref, unsupported/blocked cannot ready/start. accepted jobs carry frozen scope/progress. terminal done/stopped requires result; active/stopping may have progress but not terminal result. Done confirmed; stopped can have unknown or not_reached (or later trusted confirmed), remains stopped. Error envelope status defined; no secrets. Public evidence summaries redacted, references correspond to stored trusted records.

components: owner-scoped source/registration views and auth viewer, explicit final start, polling; no execution control
CO/PREP/KNOW/RESULT and EXEC orchestration; owns typed APIs and durable job/effect transitions, one logical app not mandatory service per role
persistent source/profile refs/registration/support keys/evidence; atomic accept/admit/fence, owner isolation; physical schema delegated
server browser session with exclusive human-auth/read/worker control, restricted registered operations and mock network; technology delegated
flow: UI H6 -> CO -> EXEC -> REMOTE; fence human and verify target; store review
UI H7 -> CO atomic accept in STORE -> runner acquires worker control -> registered operations with durable admission and typed observations
EXEC obtains profile-required goal observation -> RESULT evaluates -> CO persists terminal result -> UI H8/H9 reads
integration.workspace_proposal: Separate product root and shared schema/fixture contract, adapter modules kmong/soomgo, common app+UI+runtime+test entrypoints. Exact language, folder/package naming, dependencies, DB and remote implementation not fixed until 11/27. Independent prototype/lesson-registration worktree contracts unchanged. Do not merge whole independent branches; integrate verified functions/adapters via shared contracts.
